en-NG.consent: Welcome to IleraHer. We process short voice recordings to answer your questions. This is health information, not an emergency service. Press 1 to agree and continue, or hang up.
en-NG.pin: Enter the six digit calling PIN you set in your IleraHer account. Use your keypad. This is different from your account password.
en-NG.auth-failed: We could not verify your number and calling PIN. Please try again. You can reset your calling PIN in the app. After five incorrect attempts, calling is locked for fifteen minutes.
en-NG.record: After the tone, ask your menstrual health question. You have thirty seconds. Press hash when you finish.
en-NG.send: Press 1 to send your question, 2 to record it again, or any other key to finish.
en-NG.waiting: Please wait while IleraHer prepares your reply.
en-NG.menu: Press 1 to hear the reply again, 2 to ask a follow up question, 3 to rate this call, or 9 to finish.
en-NG.rating: How helpful was the call? Press a number from 1 to 5. One means not helpful, five means very helpful.
en-NG.rated: Thank you. Your rating has been saved.
en-NG.error: IleraHer could not complete this call. Please try again later or use the app. If your symptoms are severe or worrying, seek care from a healthcare professional.
en-NG.goodbye: Thank you for calling IleraHer. Goodbye.

yo.consent: Ẹ káàbọ̀ sí ÌleraHer. A ń ṣe àkọsílẹ̀ ohùn kúkúrú láti dáhùn ìbéèrè rẹ. Èyí jẹ́ àlàyé ìlera, kì í ṣe iṣẹ́ pàjáwìrì. Tẹ 1 láti gbà kí o sì tẹ̀síwájú, tàbí parí ìpè.
yo.pin: Tẹ PIN ìpè olónọ́mbà mẹ́fà tí o ṣètò nínú àkọọ́lẹ̀ ÌleraHer rẹ. Lo bọ́tìnì fóònù rẹ.
yo.auth-failed: A kò lè jẹ́rìí nọ́mbà àti PIN ìpè rẹ. Gbìyànjú lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i. O lè tún PIN ìpè ṣètò nínú app. Lẹ́yìn ìgbìyànjú tí kò tọ́ márùn-ún, a dá ìpè dúró fún ìṣẹ́jú mẹ́ẹ̀ẹ́dógún.
yo.record: Lẹ́yìn ohun àmì, béèrè nípa ìlera òṣù rẹ. O ní ọgbọ̀n ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá. Tẹ àmì hash nígbà tí o parí.
yo.send: Tẹ 1 láti rán ìbéèrè rẹ, 2 láti tún gbà ohùn rẹ sílẹ̀, tàbí bọ́tìnì mìíràn láti parí.
yo.waiting: Jọ̀wọ́ dúró bí ÌleraHer ṣe ń pèsè èsì rẹ.
yo.menu: Tẹ 1 láti gbọ́ èsì lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i, 2 láti béèrè sí i, 3 láti fún ìpè ní àmì, tàbí 9 láti parí.
yo.rating: Báwo ni ìpè ṣe ràn ọ́ lọ́wọ́? Tẹ nọ́mbà láti 1 sí 5. Ọ̀kan túmọ̀ sí kò ràn lọ́wọ́, márùn-ún túmọ̀ sí ó ràn lọ́wọ́ púpọ̀.
yo.rated: Ẹ ṣé. A ti fi àmì rẹ pamọ́.
yo.error: ÌleraHer kò lè parí ìpè yìí. Gbìyànjú nígbà mìíràn tàbí lo app. Bí àmì àìsàn rẹ bá le tàbí ń dà ọ́ láàmú, wá ìtọ́jú lọ́dọ̀ òṣìṣẹ́ ìlera.
yo.goodbye: Ẹ ṣé fún pípe ÌleraHer. Ó dàbọ̀.

ha.consent: Barka da zuwa IleraHer. Muna sarrafa gajerun rikodin murya don amsa tambayoyinki. Wannan bayanin lafiya ne, ba sabis na gaggawa ba. Danna 1 don amincewa da ci gaba, ko kashe kira.
ha.pin: Shigar da PIN na kira mai lambobi shida da kika saita a asusun IleraHer. Yi amfani da maballan wayarki.
ha.auth-failed: Ba mu iya tabbatar da lambarki da PIN na kira ba. Sake gwadawa. Za ki iya sake saita PIN a app. Bayan kuskure sau biyar, ana kulle kira na mintuna goma sha biyar.
ha.record: Bayan sautin, yi tambaya game da lafiyar hailarki. Kina da daƙiƙa talatin. Danna hash idan kin gama.
ha.send: Danna 1 don aika tambayarki, 2 don sake yin rikodi, ko wani maballi don gamawa.
ha.waiting: Ki jira yayin da IleraHer ke shirya amsarki.
ha.menu: Danna 1 don sake sauraron amsa, 2 don tambayar ƙarin bayani, 3 don kimanta kira, ko 9 don gamawa.
ha.rating: Yaya kiran ya taimaka? Danna lamba daga 1 zuwa 5. Ɗaya na nufin bai taimaka ba, biyar na nufin ya taimaka sosai.
ha.error: IleraHer bai iya kammala wannan kira ba. Sake gwadawa daga baya ko amfani da app. Idan alamominki sun tsananta ko suna damunki, nemi kulawa daga ma'aikacin lafiya.
ha.goodbye: Na gode da kiran IleraHer. Sai anjima.

ig.consent: Nnọọ na IleraHer. Anyị na-ahazi obere ndekọ olu iji zaa ajụjụ gị. Nke a bụ ozi ahụike, ọ bụghị ọrụ mberede. Pịa 1 iji kwenye ma gaa n'ihu, ma ọ bụ kwụsị oku.
ig.pin: Tinye PIN oku nwere ọnụọgụ isii ị haziri na akaụntụ IleraHer gị. Jiri bọtịnụ ekwentị gị.
ig.auth-failed: Anyị enweghị ike ikwenye nọmba gị na PIN oku. Gbalịa ọzọ. Ị nwere ike ịtọgharị PIN na app. Mgbe njehie ise gasịrị, a na-egbochi oku ruo nkeji iri na ise.
ig.record: Mgbe ụda gasịrị, jụọ ajụjụ gbasara ahụike oge nsọ gị. Ị nwere sekọnd iri atọ. Pịa hash mgbe ị gwụchara.
ig.send: Pịa 1 iji zipu ajụjụ gị, 2 iji dekọọ ọzọ, ma ọ bụ bọtịnụ ọzọ iji mechaa.
ig.waiting: Biko chere ka IleraHer na-akwadebe nzaghachi gị.
ig.menu: Pịa 1 iji nụ nzaghachi ọzọ, 2 iji jụọ ajụjụ ọzọ, 3 iji tụọ oku a, ma ọ bụ 9 iji mechaa.
ig.rating: Kedu ka oku si nyere gị aka? Pịa nọmba site na 1 ruo 5. Otu pụtara ọ nyeghị aka, ise pụtara ọ nyere aka nke ukwuu.
ig.error: IleraHer enweghị ike imecha oku a. Gbalịa ọzọ ma ọ bụ jiri app. Ọ bụrụ na mgbaàmà gị siri ike ma ọ bụ na-enye nsogbu, chọọ nlekọta n'aka onye ọrụ ahụike.
ig.goodbye: Daalụ maka ịkpọ IleraHer. Ka ọ dị.
